items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: He once mentioned that of all these people that he had interviewed all over world...

ctx.x: Not necessarily strictly musicians, but anybody who does anything. A man who builds bridges or whatever he does, a man is supposed to.... ........ There was a man in Sweden, what's his name, who writes sociological books on all this?

He once mentioned that of all these people that he had interviewed all over the world (what they considered the number one job?) or occupation, almost without exception they didn't know what they liked. Like anything else really. Like the old expression, their ass from a hole in the ground. They didn't know anything else really except that. They didn't know that.

Now, the problem with that is that people don't seem to be, to have been told or educated about that and they follow people that do one thing well and…
